title: Shapley value
statement: For a function $f$ from subsets of an $n$-element set to the real numbers and an element $i$, define its Shapley value at $i$ to be the Shapley expectation of the marginal difference $f(S\cup\{i\})-f(S\setminus\{i\})$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps subsets of an $n$-element set to real numbers
$i$ is an element of that set
caveat: The definition of Shapley expectation is not included, so its precise meaning cannot be stated from the supplied formal statement.
